setting: You are all allotment neighbours on the same site in a town in England, where your plots sit side by side and you have got to know each other over several seasons of digging, swapping seed and chatting by the shed. It is late November, so the beds are mostly bare: you are turning over soil, clearing bean canes and planting garlic before the ground hardens. This chat is for sharing spare compost, arranging a manure delivery and saying who is going to be down at the site.
openers: Ask who has spare horse manure
Send a photo of the frosted leeks
Remind everyone the shed padlock is sticking
Offer a spare bag of garlic cloves
opener: Offer a spare bag of garlic cloves

private_lines.Graham: You live in a town in England, spend your days on your allotment and around the house, and live alone.
private_lines.Sophie: You live in a town in England, spend your days teaching at a primary school and tending your plot after work, and live alone.

private_lines.Ellie: You live in a town in England, spend your days on shifts at a care home and your spare time on your allotment, and live alone.

text: Got a bag of spare garlic cloves, more than I need. Anyone want some? 🧄
Yes please!! What variety
No idea, label's long gone. Purple stripe-ish. Planted them last year and they were fine
Perfect thanks 🙌
I'll take some if there's enough. Doing my last bed tomorrow
Plenty. Will bag it up
me please if there's any left. working tonight but down tomorrow am
Ellie I've left a bag on the shed step for you. Rest can go to whoever gets there first
ta 🙏
Just got in. Marking all weekend might sneak down sun morning for an hour if it's not raining
Rain forecast till lunch I think. Come after
Ok
Off shift. Kitchen was mad, hands smell of onions. Garlic tomorrow then
Sorry that's a bit random
Does anyone know if the manure lorry is still on for thurs or has it moved
thurs i think. pete said 9ish. might be wrong
down now. anyone else on site?
Not yet. Frost still on the paths. Mind the bottom gate, it's stiff
ok
Garlic going in now. Bed 4
Good man. Mine's all in apart from the last row
found the bag on the step. ta again. left a couple of bulbs by the water butt if anyone wants them, don't know what they are
[photo: bulbs by the water butt]
Those look like shallots
maybe? I'll take em
Rain's holding off. Sophie you still on for after?
Yes just about to leave, be there about 2. Marking done 🙌
Good. Kettle's on ☕
Bed's dug. Loads of worm cast, can't believe it. Anyone need compost? I've got an old bin I'm not using
I'd take it. Tell me when you're down again
Did Pete confirm the lorry?
no, just what i heard. could be wrong
Had a look at the notice board, nothing. Will try Pete tomorrow
Kitchen's short again so I'm on lates Thurs, can't do the lorry before 10. Can someone else take the 9?
i'm on early thurs. could maybe do 8-9 then have to go
Ok 8 is fine, I'll be there from 8 anyway
Sorry been asleep on the sofa. Yeah happy to help with the barrow Thurs if I'm not stuck at school
Will let you know
[photo: compost bin, two bags of compost]
Sophie that's the bin? Has it got lids
Yes lids and everything
Rang Pete. Lorry's on for Thurs, 9ish like Ellie heard. He'll ring the day before to confirm
Says they need the top gate open, bottom one's too narrow for the lorry
Good. Ellie you still got 8?
yeah 8-9 then I'm off to work. told you
plus my car's making a noise again
Get it looked at before the winter. Last thing you need is stuck on the lane
[photo: bulbs by the water butt, close up]
still not sure what these are. they're quite papery
Shallots I reckon. Papery skin and the little roots
Plant them now and they'll be fine, don't wait
Mine went in last week, no bother. Pointy end up 🧄
pointy end up. got it
Thurs I'm in school till 3:30 but can get down for the barrow about 9 if I skip the staff briefing. Will confirm Weds
Sorry that's sounds dull
Not dull. Better than my Thursday, 40 covers for a Christmas do and the walk-in's making a noise
Sorry, too tired to be proper
[photo: bed 5, garlic in, a row of canes stacked by the fence]
Last bit of bean canes done. Shed's tidy for once
home. feet are dead
Marking finished. Brain is mush
Will bring the barrow gloves Thurs if anyone needs them
I've got gloves. Bring the good secateurs if you have them 🙂
